restaurant_name: Denticare Dental clinic ม.หอการค้า ( เดนติแคร์ หมอโต๊ด )
text:
The best dental clinic!!! 🥹 Even after graduating, I still come back. People I know or are close to have dental issues always bring me here because Dr. Tod takes such great care of me. He's very thorough and meticulous, and explains everything in incredible detail.
He's like a teacher teaching his students. ❤️❤️

I recently came for a consultation about a root canal. He didn't do it at the clinic, but he explained and recommended the treatment in great detail, recommending places to go. He's really great!

I had to grind my teeth and the doctor made a rubber band for me. He also recommended additional treatments I'd never heard of before. I got all the information I needed in one visit. It was so worth it!

I also had orthodontics here while I was studying. He's a specialist orthodontist. My treatment was completed within 2 years, beautiful and fast, with no problems at all. I'm so impressed!😍😍

I was surprised to see so few reviews, but this is truly a great clinic. 🥹🥹🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻

This was my second orthodontic consultation. I have a problem with my protruding lips, and this clinic has dentists who are specifically trained in orthodontics. They also have a very knowledgeable dentist who demonstrated tartar removal.
The downside is that this branch doesn't have an X-ray or dental impression machine. I had to pay 1200 baht for the impressions, which would be included in a promotion at another branch. I highly recommend this clinic for anyone who wants to get braces. I'll keep updating you all. ❤
